text: In Gatlin, Nebraska, ringed by cornfields, the boy preacher Isaac led the children to [murder every adult in a single uprising|threat|dangerous children] for a god called He Who Walks Behind the Rows. Three years later the doctor Burt and his wife Vicky, [driving through on their way to Seattle|who_suffers|newcomers and travellers], hit a boy whose throat was already cut. The children [tie Vicky to a cross in the corn|wants|the sacrifice demanded], while in the church a boy who has [turned eighteen must go to the rows|rules|it chooses who dies].
